Here is a Python script to generate a palindrome:

```python
def create_palindrome():
    half = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
    full = half + half[::-1]
    palindrome_length = 255
    half_len = palindrome_length // 2
    
    # Generate the first half of the palindrome.
    first_half = full[:half_len]
    
    if palindrome_length % 2 != 0:
        middle_char = full[half_len]
        return first_half + middle_char + first_half[::-1]
    else:
        return first_half + first_half[::-1]

print(create_palindrome())
```

Please note that because the string is composed of all alphanumeric characters, it will be significantly larger than 255 characters due to repeating strings. You can adjust the `half` variable to contain only a smaller set of characters if you need it to fit within 255 characters.

Also, generating such a large palindrome might take some time on lower-end devices.
